newsitem.title: JAPAN: Money growth shows Japan economy recovering--BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Money growth shows Japan economy recovering--BOJ.

text.p: Japan's August money supply growth confirms that the country's economy is still recovering, a Bank of Japan official told reporters on Wednesday.

Japan's broadly defined money supply average of M2 plus certificates of deposit (CDs) grew 3.7 percent in August from a year earlier, but was unchanged from the July figure, the BOJ announced earlier.

"Although one cannot judge the overall economy just by the money supply figures, the data is in line with our view that the economy is gradually recovering. The figure does not change our view," the official said.

He added that the overall trend in money supply remained unchanged from a month earlier. However, one characteristic was that money shifted to bank deposits from trust funds in August amid slow bank lending, which contributed to the growth in money supply.
